'''Nogometni klub Slaven Belupo''' ({{langx|en|Slaven Belupo Football Club}}), often referred to as '''Slaven Belupo''', is a Croatian professional [[association football|football]] [[sports club|club]] based in the city of [[Koprivnica]] in the north of Croatia. They play their home matches at [[Gradski stadion u Koprivnici|Gradski Stadion]] in Koprivnica. They compete in the [[Croatian Football League]] (HNL), the top tier of [[Croatian football league system|Croatian football]]."}}
